About Us

Your trusted partner for professional electric tools and hardware. Committed to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

Who We Are

HOLGENVY (Shandong Haojin Wanhui International Trade Co., Ltd.) is a leading manufacturer and exporter of professional electric tools, power tools, hardware tools, and metal products based in Qingdao, China.

With over 10 years of industry experience, we have built a reputation for delivering high-quality products at competitive prices to clients across 30+ countries. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility and dedicated R&D team enable us to provide OEM and ODM services tailored to your market needs.

We are committed to continuous innovation, strict quality control, and exceptional customer service. Whether you need standard products or custom solutions, HOLGENVY is your reliable manufacturing partner.

Company Building

Our Mission

To empower global businesses with reliable, high-quality tools and equipment that enhance productivity and safety. We strive to be the preferred manufacturing partner through innovation, integrity, and excellence.

Our Vision

To become a globally recognized brand in the power tool industry, known for quality, innovation, and sustainable manufacturing practices. We aim to expand our reach to 50+ countries by 2030.

Our Journey

2014

Company Founded

HOLGENVY was established in Qingdao, China with a focus on electric tool manufacturing and international trade.

2016

Factory Expansion

Expanded manufacturing facility to 10,000+ square meters with automated production lines.

2018

ISO 9001 Certification

Achieved ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification, marking our commitment to international standards.

2020

Global Expansion

Extended market reach to Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia with dedicated export teams.

2023

R&D Center Launch

Established in-house R&D center focusing on brushless motor technology and smart power tools.

2025

30+ Countries Served

Now serving clients across 30+ countries with a comprehensive product portfolio and OEM/ODM capabilities.
